dashboard.settings.autoAcceptHelp: Orders are confirmed by themselves. When the requested slot is full, the order is moved to the next available slot. It only confirms when there is capacity. Orders with a customer note (e.g. an allergy) still need to be confirmed.
dashboard.settings.layoutHelp: How items appear on the Add an order screen.
dashboard.settings.layoutTabsHelp: Only one category is shown at a time. Tap a category to switch. Best for long menus, where every item is always in the same place.
dashboard.settings.layoutScrollHelp: All items are shown in one scrolling list, each category has a heading. No category buttons — you scroll to move around. Best for short menus, where you can see almost everything at once.
dashboard.settings.paidStepHelp: Adds a Confirm button when you add an order yourself, so you can place it now and take payment later.
dashboard.settings.takesCashHelp: Splits the payment button into “Cash” and “Card”.
dashboard.settings.orderReadyHelp: Show a “Mark as ready” button on the orders screen. The kitchen display is set separately. Customers are emailed whenever an order is marked ready.
dashboard.settings.buzzerPromptTitle: Remind me to add a buzzer
dashboard.settings.buzzerPromptHelp: Opens the buzzer grid right after you place an order, so the number goes on the board while the customer is still in front of you. When off, you can still add a buzzer any time by tapping the order, but nothing will remind you. Useful if you hand out buzzers, easy to turn off if not.
dashboard.settings.cardsHelp: Turn this off when there is a card problem, and customers will still order normally but pay at the truck. Orders keep coming in; only the card step stops.
dashboard.settings.cardsScope: This is for your whole truck, on every event, and stays off until you turn it on again.
dashboard.settings.soundsHelp: The on/off switch is on each screen; each device controls its own sound.
